twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a second step at sign-in using an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy.
twoFactor.step1: Open your authenticator app and add a new account.
twoFactor.step2: Enter the key below (or open the link), then it will show a 6-digit code.
twoFactor.step3: Type that code here to finish enabling two-factor.
twoFactor.backupWarning: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.disableHint: Enter a current authenticator code or a backup code to confirm.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code is incorrect or expired.

commandPalette.title: Quick search and actions
commandPalette.description: Search pages, projects, and actions, then press Enter to navigate.

experience.clientGuide: Check your project details, review the design when it is ready, and send questions to your project manager.
experience.pmGuide: Review assigned clients, prepare project designs, and keep tasks and deadlines current.
experience.chiefGuide: Review new clients, assign project managers, and check projects awaiting a decision.
experience.offline: You are offline. Reconnect before saving or sending.
experience.previewHelp: Review saved previews here. Use a desktop for the interactive 3D workspace. Approval applies to the current design.
experience.noPreview: No preview is available. Ask your project manager to share one before approving.
experience.historical: This is an earlier version. Switch to the current version to approve.
experience.updated: The design changed. Review the latest preview before continuing.
experience.failed: Could not load the data. Please try again.
experience.detailUnavailable: Some invoice details or payment records could not be loaded. Reopen the invoice to retry.

awaiting.title: Awaiting your decision
awaiting.body: Quotes your agency has sent that you have not yet accepted or declined.
awaiting.note: A quote past its validity date is no longer counted here.

validity.title: Quote validity
validity.body: The date the priced work is guaranteed until. Material and stand costs move, so a quote cannot be held open indefinitely.

deciding.title: Accepting or declining
deciding.body: Accepting confirms the price and lets your agency start. Declining asks for a revision; say what needs to change and they will send a new quote.
deciding.note: Neither uses a design revision round.

progress.title: Production progress
progress.body: How far your stand has moved through the agency's own stages, from first brief to handover on site.
progress.note: It tracks the build, not your approvals. Approving a design does not move it on its own.

actionRequired.title: Action required
actionRequired.body: Your agency is waiting on you for this one. Open the design or the approvals list to see what is outstanding.

timeline.title: Recent activity
timeline.body: The last five times your project moved between stages, newest first.

actions.title: What these open
actions.body: Each one opens the page for this project in particular, not the portal's default stand.
actions.note: Documents are shared across your whole account, so that one is not project-specific.

status.title: Final and in review
status.body: Final means your agency has signed the file off. In review means it is still being checked internally and may change.
status.note: Nothing here is waiting on you. Your own approvals live on the design page.

categories.title: Categories
categories.body: The filing your agency uses, so only the categories they have actually used appear here.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.body: The same stages as the bar above, read from the one progress figure, so the two always agree.
milestones.note: A tick means the build has passed that point, not that you approved it.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.body: The last few things your agency did on your account, newest first. It refreshes on its own while this page is open.
